scope: Read-only audit of Hunt personal hunter and existing reference-yautja source pack, bounded by current source and contracts.
identity: reference-yautja (draft art identity; no live roster binding)

statusDefinitions.source-missing: No native sequence for this action in the existing personal-hunter source pack. This is not a statement that no artwork exists for any roster character.
statusDefinitions.generic-rig: Gameplay exists and current body motion is produced from transformed parts.
statusDefinitions.draft-source-exists: Artwork exists but is not artist-approved, identity-bound or consumed as that action in Hunt.
statusDefinitions.integration-missing: No current whole-body Hunt adapter or clip binding.
statusDefinitions.presentation-phase-needed: Gameplay event exists, but no persistent visual phase clock exists for the proposed gesture.

genericRig.claim: Hunt selects extract/climb/jump/fall/run/idle and invokes a rig, not the whole-body atlas renderer.

layeredRendering.claim: Character is composed from transformed body and equipment layers.

comboTiming.claim: Three light combo timing baselines in seconds.

techniqueTiming.claim: Heavy, aerial, guard-break, throw and execution timing.

variableRecovery.claim: Light recovery depends on equipped profile cooldown.

defenseWindow.claim: Parry can be consumed early; dodge velocity and invulnerability use real state.

weaponBinding.claim: Techniques choose available active combistick or wristblades fallback.

meleeInput.claim: Real input routes aerial, parry, light, heavy, guard-break and throw/execution.

backwardRunning.claim: Ground velocity follows input; facing is not forced by movement while aiming.

climb.claim: Existing climb motion uses signed vertical velocity, with downward-positive coordinates.

landing.claim: A real transition to grounded exists and emits landing noise; no landing pose clock is stored.

scan.claim: Scan is an event/pulse, not an authored body clip.

heal.claim: Medicomp applies recovery immediately; cooldown is not a body animation clock.

injury.claim: Damage flashes/invulnerability and death pause lack authored body motion phases.

fieldWork.claim: Field work has approach/work/secure presentation phases but is solved by rig joints.

trophyVictory.claim: Trophy lift/hold/settle has a real duration-driven progress value.

fullBodyContract.claim: Whole anatomy and separate customizable equipment are required; metadata validity is not runtime coverage.

sourcePack.claim: Existing source pack declares 288 drawings, draft status and no roster binding.

constraints: The 14 artActionId strings are production labels. They do not create engine enums or engine clip IDs.
This proposed 304-drawing batch is new source production, not 304 validated runtime clips. At audit time its status is planned.
The existing V2.1 pack contributes 288 source drawings for six stance/emote actions; its 468 playback references and reversed exits are not additional drawings.
One right-facing production lot does not cover left-facing gameplay. Native left artwork and review remain separate; do not mirror or substitute an opposite side silently.

The personal-hunter full-body composite may be useful art, but Expedition requires whole anatomy with separate customizable equipment families. This pack does not satisfy that modular contract by metadata alone.
Atlas draft status must remain draft pending human artistic approval. Technical alpha/rect/hash checks cannot grant validated.
Hunt uses elapsed seconds, not PIT fixed 60-tick action timing. Review FPS is not authoritative gameplay time.
More source drawings do not guarantee every drawing is visible during a short action at the eventual display rate. Fit phase selection to actual elapsed/remaining seconds without extending gameplay.
The camera, standing body scale and same equipment anatomy must remain constant across all drawings. Source root motion and world movement must not both translate the character.
Airborne pivots use a standing-reference pelvis/baseline rather than the current tucked feet; ground contact is supplied by the simulation.
Parry is active immediately and can end early when consumed; dodge invulnerability also begins immediately. Do not invent startup gating.
Landing is an observed collision event, not a current animation enum. Add only a future interruptible presentation cursor if integration is undertaken.
No global roster-completeness claim follows from this audit. Existing Feral/Scar workbook studies and v91/v92 costume-specific actions are not interchangeable with this personal hunter.
